name: Fetje Westerhof
reason: Health rule: her own site (fetje.nl, Praktijk Fetje, Joure, Netherlands) sells Quantum-Touch on a long list of conditions it says can be treated (headaches, high blood pressure, scoliosis, rheumatism, sciatica, whiplash, burn-out and more), and also offers Quantum-Allergy and allergy testing, so the core Quantum-Touch work is condition-led. Borderline: her gemstone-therapy, pendulum and biotensor workshops are clean, so the owner may wish to reconsider.
